Q: Getting all direct Reports from Active Directory A:

I tried with this INSTRUCTION under my WINDOWS CMD:

for /f "delims=" %u in ('dsquery * -filter "(&(objectCategory=person)(objectClass=user)(sAMAccountName=ABCDEFG))" -attr directReports -l') do @dsget user "%u" -samid -email|find "samid" /v|find "dsget" /v

The result is adequate fo me. :)
